bug: Reset is incorrectly qualified by the pulse state in the divider.
trigger: With start_stop high, assert reset asynchronously after the terminal-count clock has raised one_sec_pulse and cleared counter, then deassert reset before the next clk edge.
effect: The reset event takes the normal counting branch, leaving counter at 1 rather than 0; the next one_sec_pulse occurs one clock early relative to a clean reset.

edits.old:
always @(posedge clk or posedge reset) begin
        if (reset) begin
edits.new:
always @(posedge clk or posedge reset) begin
        if (reset && !one_sec_pulse) begin
